premise: Caterpillar wants to count the little lights of a summer night but can't see past the grass; she climbs up on Mushroom and rears up tall, Firefly's friends glow back one by one — ten little lights to count — and then Mushroom's glittery sneeze adds a hundred more.
inspiration: Counting-rhyme lullabies (Over in the Meadow, folk), turned into a night-sky count that ends in giggles and sleep.
lesson: Friends can lift you up to see the world.

en-US.title: Caterpillar Counts the Lights
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar had heard that summer nights were full of little lights, and she wanted to count them. But down in the grass, she couldn't see a thing. {caterpillar:face sad} Grass, grass, and more grass. Then up popped {mushroom:enter} Mushroom. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] "Climb up on me." {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Up crawled Caterpillar, {caterpillar:face happy} onto the red cap, and {caterpillar:live look-up hold} reared up tall. [in awe] There was the sky, and the moon, round and bright! But where were the little lights? Sleepy {butterfly:enter} Butterfly came fluttering by. {butterfly:go under mushroom} She tucked herself under Mushroom's cap and {butterfly:live rest hold} folded her wings. Then {firefly:enter} Firefly came flying over. "Watch," she whispered. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} She glowed her brightest. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} And all across the meadow, little lights glowed back. [excited] One… two, three… four, five, six… seven, eight, nine… TEN! {mushroom:live sneeze} Then Mushroom sneezed. {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! Glitter everywhere! Eleven? Twelve? A HUNDRED! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Caterpillar laughed and wiggled all over. [softly] And she {caterpillar:live sleep hold} fell asleep before she got to a hundred and one. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Firefly waved goodnight. "The lights will be here tomorrow." {canvas:fireflies stop}

es-ES.title: Oruga cuenta las lucecitas
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} [softly] {caterpillar:enter} Oruga había oído que las noches de verano se llenan de lucecitas, y quería contarlas. Pero allá abajo, entre la hierba, no veía nada. {caterpillar:face sad} Hierba, hierba y más hierba. Entonces asomó {mushroom:enter} Seta. {mushroom:face happy} [whispers] —Súbete a mí. {caterpillar:go on mushroom} Oruga trepó {caterpillar:face happy} hasta el sombrero rojo y {caterpillar:live look-up hold} se estiró bien alta. [in awe] ¡Allí estaba el cielo, con la luna redonda y brillante! Pero ¿y las lucecitas? {butterfly:enter} Mariposa pasó revoloteando, con mucho sueño. {butterfly:go under mushroom} Se acurrucó bajo el sombrero de Seta y {butterfly:live rest hold} plegó las alas. Entonces llegó volando {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga. —Mira —susurró. {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} Y brilló con todas sus fuerzas. {canvas:fireflies 0.6} Y por todo el prado, otras lucecitas le contestaron. [excited] Una… dos, tres… cuatro, cinco, seis… siete, ocho, nueve… ¡DIEZ! {mushroom:live sneeze} Entonces Seta estornudó. {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! ¡Purpurina por todas partes! ¿Once? ¿Doce? ¡CIEN! {caterpillar:live look-up resume} Oruga se rió y se meneó enterita. [softly] Y {caterpillar:live sleep hold} se quedó dormida antes de llegar a ciento una. {firefly:face happy} {firefly:live wave} Luciérnaga le dijo adiós con la patita: —Mañana las lucecitas seguirán aquí. {canvas:fireflies stop}

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful
